description: REEF3D::CORAL two-body absorber in FNPF 2D (X 20 2, STL): a float released 2 cm above its equilibrium and a deeper second float ("spar") 1.2 m away in regular waves, the spar on a heave joint to the ground, the float on a prismatic joint to the spar with a PTO damper; the FNPF loads and the added mass with the cross terms of the two bodies go to CORAL; REEF3D_FNPF_6DOF and REEF3D_CORAL compared.
covers: CORAL joint between fluid bodies, PTO in it
